retention.title: Audit log retention & anonymization
retention.subtitle: GDPR article 5 (minimization) and article 17 (right to erasure)
retention.rgpdDesc: Audit logs preserve the history of actions (ISO 27001 A.5.36 evidence). Past the «full retention» threshold, personal data (user, IP, user-agent, payload) is replaced with anonymized values. Past the «anonymized retention» threshold, the row is permanently deleted. Anonymization is irreversible.
retention.policyHint: Enter a number of days, or «NEVER» to suspend the stage (legal hold mode).
retention.fullDaysHelp: After this many days, PII fields (userId, IP, user-agent, payload) are anonymized. Default: 90.
retention.anonymizedDaysHelp: After this many days from creation, the row is permanently deleted. Default: 730 (2 years).
retention.runNowHint: Triggers the anonymization & purge cycle immediately, without waiting for the daily cron (04:00 UTC).
retention.runNowExplain: Manual action restricted to super-admins. The operation is itself audited.
retention.runConfirm: Run audit log anonymization and purge now? Anonymization is irreversible.

errors.run: Could not run the anonymization cycle.
errors.invalidFull: Invalid full retention (positive integer or NEVER).
errors.invalidAnon: Invalid anonymized retention (positive integer or NEVER).
errors.fullGteAnon: Full retention must be strictly less than anonymized retention.
